ISSUE_KIND: road_damage
ISSUE: Large sinkhole in the middle of Tecumseh Street
DETAILS: The photo shows a massive sinkhole that has opened up across a concrete road surface, exposing the soil and structure beneath. A makeshift wooden frame with yellow caution tape and a leaning metal sign post have been placed inside/around the hole as a warning.
ORGANIZATION: Prince George's County
DEPARTMENT: Department of Public Works and Transportation (DPW&T)
WHY: Tecumseh Street in Adelphi is located in an unincorporated area of Prince George's County where the county government provides local services. The DPW&T Office of Highway Maintenance is responsible for the repair of sinkholes and roadway failure on county-maintained roads.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "As part of the Prince George's County Roadway Preservation Program, maintenance includes the repair of sinkholes and potholes, shoulder repair, removal and replacement of concrete curb and gutter, sidewalks, driveway aprons, the installation of underdrains, the installation and/or upgrade of handicapped access ramps per ADA standards and the repair/resurfacing of the roadway pavement."
